controls.title: Right to Know What Personal Information is Collected
controls.description: A consumer shall have the right to request that a business that collects personal information about the consumer disclose the categories and specific pieces of personal information the business has collected about that consumer.
assessment_objectives: Verify process for handling right to know requests

controls.title: Right to Deletion
controls.description: A consumer shall have the right to request that a business delete any personal information about the consumer which the business has collected from the consumer. A business that receives a verifiable consumer request shall delete the consumer's personal information from its records and direct any service providers to delete the consumer's personal information from their records.
assessment_objectives: Verify deletion request process and execution

controls.title: Right to Correction
controls.description: A consumer shall have the right to request a business that maintains inaccurate personal information about the consumer to correct that inaccurate personal information, taking into account the nature of the personal information and the purposes of the processing.

controls.title: Right to Know — Categories and Purposes
controls.description: A consumer shall have the right to request that a business that collects personal information disclose: the categories of personal information collected, the categories of sources, the business or commercial purpose for collecting, the categories of third parties with whom the business shares, and the specific pieces of personal information collected.
assessment_objectives: Verify disclosure of categories and purposes

controls.title: Right to Know — Disclosure of Selling/Sharing
controls.description: A consumer shall have the right to request that a business that sells or shares the consumer's personal information disclose the categories of personal information sold or shared, the categories of third parties to whom the information was sold or shared, identified by category per purpose.

controls.title: Right to Opt-Out of Sale/Sharing
controls.description: A consumer shall have the right, at any time, to direct a business that sells or shares personal information about the consumer to third parties not to sell or share the consumer's personal information. The business shall provide a clear and conspicuous link on its internet homepage titled 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information'.
controls.supplemental_guidance: CPRA expanded this to include 'sharing' for cross-context behavioral advertising.
assessment_objectives: Verify opt-out mechanism is provided and functional

controls.title: Right to Limit Use of Sensitive Personal Information
controls.description: A consumer shall have the right to direct a business that collects sensitive personal information about the consumer to limit its use and disclosure to that use which is necessary to perform the services or provide the goods reasonably expected by an average consumer.
assessment_objectives: Verify mechanism to limit sensitive PI use

controls.title: Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.description: A business shall not discriminate against a consumer because the consumer exercised any of the consumer's rights under this title, including but not limited to denying goods or services, charging different prices, providing different quality, or suggesting the consumer will receive a different price or quality.
assessment_objectives: Verify non-discrimination for exercising privacy rights

controls.title: Business Response Requirements
controls.description: A business shall make available to consumers two or more designated methods for submitting requests, including at a minimum a toll-free telephone number. The business shall respond to verifiable consumer requests within 45 days of receipt, extendable by an additional 45 days with notice.
assessment_objectives: Verify request intake methods and response timelines

controls.title: Notice and Opt-Out Requirements
controls.description: A business that is required to comply with the opt-out shall provide a clear and conspicuous link on the business's internet homepage, titled 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information' that enables a consumer to opt out of the sale or sharing of the consumer's personal information.
assessment_objectives: Verify opt-out links and notice requirements

controls.title: Definitions and Scope
controls.description: For purposes of this title: 'Business' means a sole proprietorship, partnership, LLC, corporation, association, or other legal entity that is organized or operated for profit; collects consumers' personal information; determines the purposes and means of processing; does business in California; and satisfies one or more thresholds (annual gross revenue exceeding $25 million, handles PI of 100,000+ consumers/households, or derives 50%+ revenue from selling/sharing PI).
assessment_objectives: Verify business meets CCPA/CPRA applicability thresholds

controls.title: Exemptions
controls.description: The obligations imposed on businesses by this title shall not restrict a business's ability to comply with federal, state, or local laws; comply with civil, criminal, or regulatory inquiry or investigation; cooperate with law enforcement; exercise or defend legal claims; collect, use, retain, sell, share, or disclose consumer information that is deidentified or in the aggregate.

controls.title: Private Right of Action (Data Breaches)
controls.description: Any consumer whose nonencrypted and nonredacted personal information is subject to an unauthorized access and exfiltration, theft, or disclosure as a result of the business's violation of the duty to implement and maintain reasonable security procedures and practices may institute a civil action for statutory damages between $100 and $750 per consumer per incident or actual damages, whichever is greater.
assessment_objectives: Verify reasonable security measures to prevent breach liability

controls.title: Administrative Enforcement
controls.description: Any business, service provider, contractor, or other person that violates this title shall be liable for an administrative fine of not more than two thousand five hundred dollars ($2,500) for each violation, or seven thousand five hundred dollars ($7,500) for each intentional violation or violations involving the personal information of consumers the business has actual knowledge are under 16 years of age.
controls.supplemental_guidance: CPRA created the California Privacy Protection Agency (CPPA) for enforcement.
assessment_objectives: Verify compliance program to avoid enforcement actions

controls.title: CPPA Rulemaking Authority
controls.description: The California Privacy Protection Agency shall have authority to adopt regulations including: requiring businesses to submit risk assessments with respect to their processing of personal information, requiring cybersecurity audits, and establishing rules regarding automated decisionmaking technology.
controls.supplemental_guidance: CPRA granted the CPPA broad rulemaking authority.
assessment_objectives: Verify awareness of and compliance with CPPA regulations

controls.title: Cybersecurity Audit
controls.description: Businesses whose processing of consumers' personal information presents significant risk to consumers' privacy or security shall perform an annual cybersecurity audit. The audit must be thorough and independent.
controls.supplemental_guidance: CPRA requirement - regulations pending from CPPA.
assessment_objectives: Verify annual cybersecurity audit for high-risk processing
